detail.longDescription: I'm creating a bank ATM system. The page I'm currently designing is one that prompts the user to enter their pin and there's an animation demonstrating that action to them, but the issue is that the finger pushing the buttons when pressing (I used scale() to add realism of a button click) is either moving away from the button while the button is going down, or moves to the button on its way up, In essence I want it to seem as if my pointer is clicking my button. .key { height : 80px; width : 80px; background : #444; border-radius : 12px; display : flex; align-items : center; justify-content : center; color : white; font-size : 28px; box-shadow : 10px 6px 0 #334155; } .key.pressed { box-shadow : 3px 2px 0 #0F172A; transform : translate(5px, 3px); } .machine { position : relative; } .finger { position : absolute; width : 80px; height : 80px; top : 0px; left : 0px; border-radius : 50%; background-color : red; animation : push 10s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes push { 0% {transform : translate(90px, 90px);} 10% {transform : translate(90px, 90px) scale(0.5);} /*5*/ 15% {transform : translate(90px, 90px) scale(1);} 20% {transform : translate(0, 180px) scale(0.5);} /*7*/ 25% {transform : translate(0, 180px) scale(1);} 30% {transform : translate(180px, 180px) scale(0.5);} /*9*/ 35% {transform : translate(180px, 180px) scale(1);} 40%{transform : translate(180px, 0) scale(0.5);} /*3*/ 45% {transform :translate(180, 0) scale(1);} 50% {transform : translate(90px, 270px) scale(0.5);} /*0*/ 55% {transform : translate(90px, 270px) scale(1);} 60% {transform : translate(0, 180px) scale(0.5);} /*7*/ 65% {transform : translate(0, 180px) scale(1);} 70% {transform : translate(90px, 0) scale(0.5);} 75% {transform : translate(90px, 0) scale(1);} 80% {transform : translate(180px, 90px) scale(0.5);} 85% {transform : translate(180px, 90px) scale(1);} 90% {transform : translate(180px, 0) scale(0.5);} 95% {transform : translate(180px, 0) scale(1);} 100% {transform : translate(90px, 90px) scale(0.5);} } .keypad :nth-child(5) { animation : press 4.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes press { 0% {transform : translate(0, 0);} 5% {transform : translate(1px, 1px);} 15% {transform : translate(2px, 1px);} 50% {transform : translate(5px, 3px);} 100% {transform : translate(0, 0);} }
